name: The My Clips page next to Jellyfin Enhanced, in the je sandbox, Jellyfin Enhanced 12.12 with its quality and rating tags on (the pinned fixture): the My Clips page searched for the probe's clips renders every clip the API lists, and after JE's observers have had their time no row has changed (JE's card tags decorate card images; our rows carry none), every row shown with its actions; a preview opens and closes. The home page's JE tags are recorded as evidence that JE's tags run.

steps.name: playing
steps.waitFor: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel video'); return !!v && v.readyState >= 2 && v.currentTime > 0.5 && !v.error; })()

steps.name: Escape closes it
steps.script: document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-preview-download').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); return !document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop');
